title: Bathing in Skyrim Renewed integration for SkyrimNet
tagline: Action for NPC to find water and go to it, bath in it or request proper items for it, and Awareness prompt for dirtiness level and bathing action.
description:
Plugins that add action and awareness for "Bathing in Skyrim Renewed".
Add action for NPC to find and travel to water, take bath or request for the missing component for cleaning themself and dual action for cleaned the player or other NPC thru "Wash Me" if installed.
Add awareness of dirtiness level thru SeverAction's survival prompt and allow NPC's to know when they bath and with who, and surrounding NPC to also be aware of who is bathing close by.
All dirtiness variable and bathing requirement are directly linked to BiSR, so dirtiness level and speed of it is done in BiSR MCM menu.
author: telord72612
changelog:
V3.0.0 Update
Reworked the prompt send to LLM on dirtiness Tiers so to reflect BiSR tiers
Reword on dual wash mechanism, message box prompt for SE/AE, in VR, the NPC will kneel/sit on a log and wait for the player to go place themself in front/behind them. NPC will be told if the Player don't show up.
StandPoint V2 and WaterFinder V1.6 updated, big amelioration on travel to water around obstacle. NavMesh scanning, priority change, occlusion box on undisclosed obstacle, NPC traveling to water by themself should now work in 98% of location, including dungeon, different level, pass wall or needing to pass around a ledge or a obstacle.
Everything is tested in VR. Should be SE/AE compatible except the walk into water with StandPoint V2, it use the old "that direction that far, walk" feature.
